source_text: Balac mittit ad Balaam ut maledicat Israel. Initium historiae Balaam: prophetia mixta, nunc vituperabilis nunc laudabilis.
pass_a_gloss: Balak sends to Balaam that he-may-curse Israel. Beginning of-history of-Balaam: prophecy mixed, now blameworthy now praiseworthy.
pass_b_english: [[Balak sends for Balaam to curse Israel >> Bible:Numbers 22:5-6]]. So begins Balaam’s story — a mixed prophecy, now blameworthy, now praiseworthy.
